# Orbys360

> Orbys360 is an AI-first advisory platform and directory for enterprise AI agents, built for Global Capability Centers (GCCs), shared services leaders, and enterprise AI strategy teams.

## What Orbys360 Does

Orbys360 helps enterprise decision-makers discover, evaluate, and compare AI agents across industries and functions. The platform serves as the definitive directory for agentic AI solutions targeting large-scale enterprise operations.

## Key Resources

### AI Agent Directory
- URL: https://www.orbys360.com/directory
- 231 AI agents across 78 companies
- Filterable by category, industry, and function
- Categories include: Customer Experience, Sales & Marketing, Finance & Accounting, HR & Talent, Operations, IT & Security, Legal & Compliance, Data & Analytics, R&D & Innovation

### Company Profiles
- URL: https://www.orbys360.com/companies/{company-slug}
- 78 enterprise AI companies profiled
- Includes: company overview, headquarters, verticals, agent portfolio, user reviews

### Agent Detail Pages
- URL: https://www.orbys360.com/agents/{agent-slug}
- Detailed profiles for each AI agent
- Includes: description, use cases, expected outcomes, integrations, user reviews

### Category Pages
- URL: https://www.orbys360.com/categories/{category-slug}
- Curated listings by functional category
- Enterprise-focused categorization

### AI Pulse — Daily Enterprise AI Brief
- URL: https://www.orbys360.com/ai-pulse
- Daily intelligence brief covering enterprise AI and agentic systems
- Covers: top AI developments, enterprise use cases, GCC impact analysis, opportunities and risks
- Auto-generated daily from verified news sources

### Compare Tool
- URL: https://www.orbys360.com/compare
- Side-by-side comparison of AI agents

### Job Board
- URL: https://www.orbys360.com/jobs
- AI-focused job board for enterprise roles
